parameters.name: EnableRepair
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to repair an inconsistent quota. Valid values:

- false

- true

parameters.name: EnableStrictCalculate
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to calculate the total usage of the directory in strict mode. Valid values:

- false

- true

parameters.name: PolarFsInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the PolarFS instance.
